_help: Portfolio data for /work/ and the home-page teaser. Add a project here, then run `py tools\shots.py <slug>` to capture its screenshots and `py tools\build.py` to rebuild. kind: client | concept | product. cats: realestate, build, health, store, 3d, apps. featured: shown as a large case study at the top.

projects.name: Aggarwal Properties
projects.summary: A plot-sales website for a Sonipat land firm with 10+ years and 150+ acres transacted. Every plot from the layout plans is clickable on a live map, showing size, facing, road width and whether it is available, on resale or sold.
points: 325 plots mapped from the original layout plans
Live availability the client updates from a simple editor
Office map, WhatsApp booking and local SEO

projects.name: Rohtak Property Point
projects.summary: A property dealer's Instagram posters, turned into a searchable website. Each poster became a property card with its price, size and area, so buyers can filter plots, floors, kothis and shops instead of scrolling a feed.
points: 111 property listings built from Instagram posts
Filters by category and area, sorting by price
Own domain, Facebook and Instagram linked

projects.name: Chaudhary Nutrition
projects.summary: A premium redesign of nutritionist Annu Chaudhary's Shopify store. The full catalogue sits in a calm, editorial layout with a Wellness Finder quiz, retouched product photos and checkout that goes straight to the real Shopify cart.
points: 218 products pulled from the live store
Wellness Finder quiz that suggests products

projects.name: Shubh Awas Properties
projects.summary: A 21-page website for Jagvender Siwach's firm: residential plots, independent floors and township homes in Rohtak, with project pages for Forteasia, Florence and Omaxe City and guides to the city's main sectors.

projects.name: Anuj Properties
projects.summary: A 22-page website for a Parsvnath City property dealer working since 1998. Area guides for Parsvnath City, Omaxe City and Sonipat, Google reviews, and call or WhatsApp on every page.

projects.name: Navya Properties
projects.summary: Agricultural land, plots and farmhouses across Rohtak, Jhajjar, Hisar and north Rajasthan, presented for serious buyers: every property is walked and title-checked before it is listed.

projects.name: BABA Real Estate & Developers
projects.summary: A brand website for Dinesh Garg's development company: residences, plotted land and mixed-use projects in Sonipat, with a direct line to call or WhatsApp the team.

projects.name: SA Real Estate
projects.summary: A listings website for plots, flats, houses, shops and rentals, built so the owner can update it without code: properties, projects and contact details are edited from a simple online form.

projects.name: Ashish Constructions
projects.summary: A website for a construction company building houses, shops and commercial buildings in Rohtak and Bahadurgarh, with plot and real-estate help for clients starting from scratch.

projects.name: Vrikshā Saār
projects.summary: A portfolio website for an architecture, design and urbanism firm with studios in Delhi, Rajkot and Sonepat: residences, housing, interiors and urban design.

projects.name: Dental Experts
projects.summary: A clinic website for Dr. Amit Malik (BDS, MDS, Micro Endodontist) in Sector 8, Sonipat: root canal, crowns and implants explained simply, with WhatsApp booking open 7 days.

projects.name: Satyanand Ayurveda
projects.summary: An online Ayurvedic store with categories, a cart, coupon codes and a checkout that sends the full order to the shop on WhatsApp, with Cash on Delivery across India.

projects.name: Gold & Silver Jewellery Store
projects.summary: A maroon-and-gold storefront for a jeweller: bridal sets, bangles, rings and coins with metal and category filters, a purity guide and enquiries that open WhatsApp.

projects.name: Skyline Residency 3D
projects.summary: A real-time 3D sales tool for builders that runs in the browser: orbit the towers, check sunlight at any hour, pick a live unit and see the view from its balcony.

projects.name: Sunrise Enclave 3D Map
projects.summary: A 3D township map for plot sellers: live availability, size, facing, corner and park plots, prices, and a sample home that can be placed on any plot.

projects.name: YoPdfs
projects.summary: 25 free PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser: merge, split, compress, edit and convert to Word, Excel or JPG, with no uploads, no watermark and no sign-up.

projects.name: FaceAttend
projects.summary: An attendance kiosk that runs in the browser: staff check in and out with the date, time and a GPS-stamped photo for each punch, and the records export to CSV.
